newsitems.title: Halloween with Dead by Daylight: LABS, Skins, Events, and Rewards
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a497fe26d3f5f4a972d6e51ee9c001a8b4e3306c.jpg[/img]

Hey, are you okay? We don’t have much time, so listen carefully.

The Killer’s out there in the Fog and our teammates are currently risking their lives to repair those generators.

… I’ve just received word on the last generator’s location. Let’s go.

Remember, we must escape together and report back what we discovered!

[h2][b]LABS Mode Collaboration: PUBG X Dead by Daylight[/b][/h2]
[u]※ Dead by Daylight is a multiplayer horror game from Behaviour Interactive Inc., where one player takes on the savage Killer role and the other four playing the Survivors. The Killer’s goal is to hunt down the Survivors while the Survivors work together to avoid getting killed.[/u]

Download and learn more about the game here: [url=https://www.deadbydaylight.com/]https://www.deadbydaylight.com/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/a2957b3b393ac55444a1851dd29bdd38b9930622.png[/img]

The Killer's out there in the Fog and our teammates are currently risking their lives to repair those generators.

One day, everything was consumed by the Fog. Just like that. Nobody knows why.

Expeditions were dispatched - us right now - to study and report back the buried secrets of the Fog. But it didn't take us long to find out something more lurked out here...

The Killer makes sure many teams don't come back from the Fog. In other words, not only do you have to reveal the Fog's mysteries and escape safely, but you also have to make sure you don't get slaughtered.

We call it the [b]Killer[/b].

The Killer makes sure many teams don’t come back from the Fog. In other words, not only do you have to reveal the Mist’s mysteries and escape safely, but you also have to make sure you don’t get slaughtered.

But before you begin, make sure to read the expedition guideline below for a higher chance of survival.
[list]    [*][b]Once a match starts, there will be a number of broken generators (3 greater than the number of Survivors) scattered throughout the map.[/b][/*]    [*][b]Survivors (three teammates) will have to work together to repair 1 more generator than the number of Survivors to activate the exit gates’ switches.[/b][/*]    [*][b]There will be a single Killer per match.[/b][/*]    [*][b]The Killer has one goal: do whatever they can to prevent every Survivor from escaping.[/b][/*][/list][h3]Survivors’ Guide[/h3]
[b]1. To win, avoid the Killer and open the exit gates to escape.[/b]

[b]2. Characteristics[/b]
[list]    [*]Three character states exist in this mode.[/*]    [*][b]Normal State[/b]        [list]            [*]Sprinting or being damaged/knocked out will reveal your trail to the Killer for 10 seconds.[/*]            [*]Your heart will beat faster and louder when the Killer is near you.[/*]            [*]Sprinting will drain your exhaust gauge. If your exhaust gauge is fully depleted, you can not sprint until the gauge regains health.[/*]            [*]Falling from a high place does not inflict damage, but it will take longer to stand upright again.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Damaged State[/b]        [list]            [*]Receiving damage in normal state will bring you to a damaged state.[/*]            [*]You will drop a consistent blood trail (lasting 4 seconds) behind you every second whenever you move.[/*]            [*]You will also moan in pain, which may alert the Killer.[/*]            [*]Using the Med Kit to heal yourself will turn you back to normal state.[list]                    [*]Other Survivors can also heal you to turn you back to normal state.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Knocked Out[/b]        [list]            [*]Receiving damage from damaged state will knock you out.[/*]            [*]Your movement speed will drastically decrease.[/*]            [*]You can not interact with any map objects.[/*]            [*]The Killer or another Survivor will be able to carry you.[/*]            [*]Your HP will slowly decrease for 4 minutes; you will die once your HP drops to 0.[/*]            [*]You can slowly heal yourself even without the Med Kit, but another Survivor must heal you in order to go back to damaged state.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]3. Generators[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ba7a35eb282ff783edf8284c127ef16d127d46ed.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]Find broken generators and use the interaction key to fix every one.[/*]    [*]A QTE will show up during repair – if you succeed, the repair gage slightly increases. If you fail, your location is revealed to the Killer and the generator’s repair gage slightly decreases.[list]            [*][u]※ QTE: Quick Time Event is an onscreen prompt requiring players to perform certain actions for the next step.[/u][/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]More than one Survivor can repair a single generator together to speed up repair time.[/*]    [*]Once the required number of generators is repaired, the location of the exit gates will show up as silhouettes on the screen.[/*]    [*]Flip the switch on the exit gate with the interaction key to escape in time.[list]            [*]Must escape through the exit altogether within [b]2[/b] minutes if no Survivor is knocked out or stuck in a Blue Zone Locker.[/*]            [*]Must escape through the exit altogether within [b]4 or more [/b]minutes if at least 1 Survivor is knocked out or stuck in a Blue Zone Locker.[/*]            [*]If every Survivor fails to escape within the specified time, the [b]Killer wins[/b].[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]If you’re the only Survivor alive, you can open the exit gate without having to repair any more generators.[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c91a2e42f95713ae411276742cae41e85e343ace.jpg[/img]

[b] 4. Against the Killer[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/94c778ead43b7169e9dfc455ac82597677128bff.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]Survivors can [b]not [/b]kill the Killer.[/*]    [*]Avoid getting damaged/knocked out and sent to the [b]Blue Zone Locker[/b]as a sacrifice by the Killer.[list]            [*]Blue Zone Locker: Holds knocked out Survivors for a certain amount of time before killing them.[/*]            [*]Blue silhouettes of knocked out Survivors are shown to other Survivors.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]When you’re knocked out and the Killer carries you, a QTE will pop up to give you a chance to stun the Killer and drop you.[/*]    [*]Survivors can also knock over randomly spawned Pallets to either gain distance while running away, or to hit the Killer at the right timing to temporarily disorient them.
 [/*][/list]
[b]5. Items[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c3fcfbbfc9deec88a754974b50ac21c240305d7c.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]You can only hold one item at the same time.[/*]    [*]Items are consumed on use.[/*]    [*]At the beginning, Survivors are randomly given one starting item among the following four:[list]            [*][b]Smoke Grenade[/b]: Creates a temporary smoke field to hinder the Killer’s vision.[/*]            [*][b]Lv. 1 Stun Grenade (2)[/b]: Use to temporarily stun the Killer.[/*]            [*][b]Lv. 1 Toolbox[/b]: Use to temporarily destroy the Blue Zone Locker. It can also be used to speed up generator repairs.[/*]            [*][b]Lv. 1 Med Kit[/b]: Use to heal yourself and earn a speed boost when healing yourself and/or your teammates.[list]                    [*]A QTE pops up during heal – if you succeed, the heal gage increases slightly. If you fail, the gage slightly decreases.[/*]                    [*]More than one Survivor (they don’t all have to be holding Med Kits) can heal a single Survivor together to speed up heal time.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Survivors can also find and pick up item crates during the match.[list]            [*][b]Lv. 2 Stun Grenade: [/b]Use to temporarily stun and hinder the Killer’s vision.[/*]            [*][b]Smoke Grenade[/b][/*]            [*][b]Lv. 2 Toolbox[/b][/*]            [*][b]Lv. 2 Med Kit[/b][/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]If you are not holding any items, the silhouettes of lootable item crates are shown on the screen.[list]            [*]If you loot an item from the crate when you already have one, the item you were holding will be dropped.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3]Killer’s Guide[/h3]
[b]1. To win, find Survivors and kill them before they escape.[/b]

[b]2. Characteristics[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/72c79f782f21b8801c2ea9fa9ce1311c66992992.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]Killers have faster movement speed than Survivors.[list]            [*]Falling from a high place does not inflict damage nor require any delay to stand upright again.[/*]            [*]However, vaulting speed is much slower.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Silhouettes of Survivors who failed to heal themselves/teammates or repair a generator are shown on the screen.[/*]    [*]Silhouettes of Survivors who rescue other Survivors from the Blue Zone Lockers are shown on the screen.[/*]    [*]Generators being repaired can be damaged with the interaction key.[/*]    [*]Knocked over pallets can be destroyed.[/*][/list]
[b]3. Items[/b]
[list]    [*]Killers can attack and/or knock out Survivors with the provided weapons:[/*]    [*][b]A loaded Win94[/b]        [list]            [*]Can obtain Win94 ammo by interacting with the Blue Zone Lockers.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Machete[/b]        [list]            [*]You can knock out a Survivor immediately with the Machete when they’re vaulting or interacting with an object.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Sticky Bomb[/b]        [list]            [*]A silhouette of the bomb you attached will show up on the screen.[/*]            [*]Can obtain 1 more Sticky Bomb 5 seconds after using the first one.[/*]            [*]You can hold up to 2 Sticky Bombs.[/*]            [*]The Sticky Bomb does not knock out Survivors.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]4. Against Survivors[/b]
[list]    [*]Knock out Survivors and carry them to Blue Zone Lockers to kill them.[list]            [*]The Killer will drop the Survivor if stunned by a Stun Grenade, etc.[/*]            [*]If every Survivor is trapped in a Blue Zone Locker, they will die immediately and end the match with the [b]Killer’s victory[/b].[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Killers must keep captured Survivors in a Blue Zone Locker for at least [b]2 minutes[/b] to kill them,[/*]    [*]OR keep Survivors captured for the second time for at least [b]1 minute[/b],[/*]    [*]OR keep Survivors captured the third time to kill them [b]immediately[/b],[/*]    [*]OR leave a knocked out Survivor on the ground for [b]4 minutes[/b].[/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/48a8f55fab3a660ac5cb38b813bd67178a3c0778.jpg[/img]

Have you got everything down? You only have limited time for this expedition, so make sure to complete as many sessions as you can within the following period.
[h3][b]Mode Schedule[/b][/h3]
[u]※ PUBG X Dead by Daylight mode will run during the following period. Dates may be adjusted.[/u]
[list]    [*][b]PC & Console[/b]        [list]            [*]PDT: October 21, 12 AM – PST November 6, 11 PM[/*]            [*]CEST: October 21, 9 AM – CET November 7, 8 AM[/*]            [*]KST: October 21, 4 PM – November 7, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3][b]Gameplay Settings[/b][/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/d6c8eccbb9f9d504e1304ae7dd8a8ad3e51a80bc.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]Once a match starts, players will be asked to select between a Survivor/Killer role.[list]            [*]If roles are not selected before the countdown, roles will be randomly selected.[/*]            [*]If every player chooses to be a Survivor, the Killer will be randomly chosen.[/*]            [*]If 2 or more players choose to be a Killer, a single player will be randomly chosen as the Killer.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Survivor – TPP[/*]    [*]Killer – FPP[/*]    [*]Min/max number of starting players: 4[/*][/list][h3]Custom Match Settings[/h3]
Enjoy PUBG X Dead by Daylight even more with custom matches.
[list]    [*]Service Period[list]            [*]PC & Console[list]                    [*]PDT: October 21, 12 AM – PST December 7, 11 PM[/*]                    [*]CEST: October 21, 9 AM – CET December 8, 8 AM[/*]                    [*]KST: October 21, 4 PM – December 8, 4 PM[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Settings[list]            [*]Number of starting players: Min. 4, max. 14[/*]            [*]Number of Killers: Min. 1, max. 3[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3][b]Notes When Playing LABS[/b][/h3][list]    [*]Press the LABS banner in the lobby to play PUBG X Dead by Daylight Mode.[/*]    [*]LABS gameplay…[list]            [*]Do not provide XP or gameplay rewards.[/*]            [*]Will not be reflected in Career/Match History.[/*]            [*]Does not support replay.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
There are things you also need to do apart from… avoiding slaughter. Complete specific missions and receive rewards! Let me explain more below.
[h2][b]PUBG X Dead by Daylight Event[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c606ce081e8981ae195a41042891e2a19cb5f7fd.png[/img]

[h3]How to Participate[/h3][list]    [*]Access the PUBG X Dead by Daylight Mission Event page by pressing the event banner in the lobby.[/*]    [*]Press the “Start Mission” button to begin.[/*]    [*]Check out what missions and rewards are available.[/*]    [*]Go back to the game and play PUBG X Dead by Daylight Mode.[/*]    [*]If you’ve completed a mission, go back to the event page and press the “Claim Reward” button.[/*]    [*]Enjoy your rewards![/*][/list][h3]Missions and Rewards[/h3][list]    [*][b]Play 1 Match [/b]to receive a [b]Dwight Unknown skin redeem code[/b], redeemable in Dead by Daylight![list]            [*][u][b]※ Installation of the Dead by Daylight game is required to redeem the skin.[/b][/u][/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Play 5 Matches [/b]to receive a [b]Dead by Daylight Killers Spray.[/b][/*]    [*][b]Reach 10 cumulative kills as a Killer [/b]to receive a [b]Dead by Daylight “The Nurse” Mask.[/b][/*]    [*](PC) Your rewards will be delivered to your Customize page as soon as you press the “Claim Reward” button in the event page.[/*]    [*](Console) Your rewards will be delivered to your Customize page by November 12 UTC.[/*][/list][h3]Event Schedule[/h3]
[u]※ The time and dates below are subject to change.[/u]
[list]    [*]PDT: October 21, 12 AM – PST November 6, 11 PM[/*]    [*]CEST: October 21, 9 AM – CET November 7, 8 AM[/*]    [*]KST: October 21, 4 PM – November 7, 4 PM[/*][/list][h3]Important Notes[/h3][list]    [*]You are required to access the event page through the PUBG X Dead by Daylight Mission Event banner in the main lobby [b]ONLY [/b]for your participation to be counted.[/*]    [*]This event is available to every region and platform.[/*]    [*]Matches playedin PUBG X Dead by Daylight mode [b]only [/b]will be counted.[/*]    [*]You can participate and receive each reward only once per account.[/*]    [*]Please make sure to participate within the event period to receive rewards.[/*]    [*]A minimum of 5 minutes (including spectating time) of gameplay will be counted as playing 1 Match.[/*]    [*]It may take up to 30 minutes for your gameplay count to be reflected on the event page.[/*]    [*]Matches played by abusing an unexpected in-game bug and/or through other unfair methods will not be counted.[/*][/list]
Lastly, before you set off to fix those generators, I heard they got some new outfits at the Store to help you look a bit more… fearsome against the Killer. Perhaps they’ll help you survive longer?

Hello players!

Hottest car in PUBG, McLaren GT! The McLaren hype continues with the McLaren Workshop Event 2!  Complete the following daily missions during the event to collect and exchange points for various rewards!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/be9ce9254504278f8e83ef9a9dcac64876be9436.png[/img]

[olist]    [*]Survive 30 min in total. (30 points)[list]            [*]In duo or squad mode, spectating time is counted.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]One kill or assist within 10 min after a match starts. (30 points)[/*]    [*]Reach Top 10. (40 points)[/*][/olist][h3][b]Event Rewards[/b][/h3]
Exchange points you acquired from missions for the following rewards!
[list]    [*]300 points – McLaren Event Loot Cache x 10[/*]    [*]300 points – McLaren Event Loot Cache x 10[/*]    [*]300 points – McLaren Event Loot Cache x 10[/*][/list][h3][b]Event Schedule[/b][/h3][list]    [*]PC[list]            [*]PDT: October 19, 0 AM – October 31, 0 AM[/*]            [*]October 19, 9 AM CEST – October 31, 8 AM CET[/*]            [*]KST: October 19, 4 PM – October 31, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Console[list]            [*]PDT: October 20, 0 AM – November 1, 0 AM[/*]            [*]October 20, 9 AM CEST – November 1, 8 AM CET[/*]            [*]KST: October 20, 4 PM – November 1, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]Special Drops 2: Happy Halloween Event[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/fa4f3c40272fec90dd637944ef50498248d2de44.png[/img]

Trick or treat! Take out your Halloween costumes and log in every day for ten days to receive all rewards. Continuous login rewards are also prepared, so don’t forget to log in daily!

[h3][b]Reward[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f418a706b90078c6cb98aba560dd30a1692eba32.png[/img]

[list]    [*]Receive [b]Hunter’s Chest[/b]after watching at least 15 minutes of a Partner’s live stream.[/*][/list][h3][b]Drops Period[/b][/h3][list]    [*]PC & Console  [list]            [*]PDT: October 11, 5 PM – October 25, 4:59 PM [/*]            [*]CEST: October 12, 2 AM – October 26, 1:59 AM  [/*]            [*]KST: October 12, 9 AM – October 26, 8:59 AM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3][b]Important Notes[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/432d85914ce9a40cce0298aa827a4a925e83ca2e.png[/img]

Hello players!

Which equipment comes to mind when you don’t have enough hands to hold all your looted items?

That’s right – [b]backpacks[/b]! Get ready, as the next theme of the 2022 Fan Art Contest series: LOOT is about to start right [u]now![/u]

Whip out your design tools, create your own [b]Level 2 Backpack[/b] design, submit your awesome works and get a chance to win prizes [u]and [/u]see your design spring to life in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS!

You don’t have to design to enjoy our Fan Art Contest this time around; you can also participate by voting for your favorite design during the public voting phase and receive a Spray reward!

Read below for the full details.
[h3]How to Participate[/h3][list]    [*][b]Submit your Design[/b]        [list]            [*][b]Download [/b]the attached template.[list]                    

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/65e298bb462652c83b5a56dbb80bf5e4ba148aa3.png[/img]

    [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Create your [b]Backpack (Level 2)[/b]design using the template.[list]            [*]Save the file.[/*]            [*]Submit the file to [b]Google Forms([url=https://forms.gle/zLVRizaP1b6ePKHF6]https://forms.gle/zLVRizaP1b6ePKHF6[/url])[/b]![/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Please make sure[/b] to add your PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS nickname, your region, game platform (Steam / PlayStation® / Xbox / etc.), and email address along with your design template file before submission.[/*]    [*][b]Vote for a Design[/b]        [list]            [*]Visit our [b]official website [/b]once the CONTEST menu is open, vote for your favorite design, and receive a Spray reward![/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/2adb320605e9469be5c985bf9325f0db67ff768c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Design Guideline[/h3][list]    [*]A total of [b]three, colored [/b]sketches are required.[list]            [*]Front side[/*]            [*]Half-side[list]                    [*]※ Half-side view: The angle between the Front and Side view (approximately 45 degrees).[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Back side[/*]            [*][b]The backpack straps and their design must be clearly shown.[/b][/*]            [*]Example image of the required angles:[list]                    [*]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/eace1864584f5ae0c3855864c6736700933cca6f.png[/img]

[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]File format: JPEG or PNG[/*]    [*]Image size: [b]At least[/b] 3840px * 2160px[/*]    [*]Please refrain from adding text/words/letters to your design as they may not be clearly shown in-game.[/*]    [*]Please keep in mind the final in-game item appearance of the winner’s design may change during development.[/*][/list][h3]Please DO NOT…[/h3][list]    [*]Use any type of design/logo/symbol hinting at a particular religious, organization, or political orientation.[/*]    [*]Use any type of design/logo/symbol symbolizing a military unit/organization.[/*]    [*]Infringe the rights of another person’s or organization’s trademark, music, logo, or image without written consent.[/*]    [*]Use any content that is obscene, offensive; sexually explicit, derogatory of any ethnic, racial, gender, religious, professional or age group; promotes alcohol abuse, illegal drugs, tobacco, actual firearms/weapons (or the use of any of the foregoing) or a particular political agenda; defames, misrepresents or contains disparaging remarks about other people or companies or communicates messages or images inconsistent with the positive images and/or good will to which we wish to associate; and/or violates any law.[/*][/list][h3]Contest Process and Judging Criteria[/h3]
We will first internally assess and select the final [b]five [/b]designs to be uploaded for public vote! The selections will be based on:
[list]    [*]Creativity[/*]    [*]How much it follows the Design Guideline[/*]    [*]How much it fits with PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS’ brand identity[/*][/list]
The five selected designs will then be available for public vote on our [b]official website[/b].
[h3][b]Contest Period[/b][/h3]

[b]Dev Comment[/b]

Hello players, PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team here.

A week ago, we introduced our change to map services for the #20.1 patch. In the Normal Match pool, Miramar was to be replaced with Deston.

We’d first like to share our intentions on this change.

As we monitor graphs on players’ map preference in all regions, we were able to see that players preferred Deston over Miramar. Also, the dodge rate in Miramar was confirmed to be highest in regions with random map selection, while the pick rate for Miramar in regions that had the map selection feature were extremely low during Update 19.1 and 19.2.

Therefore, our decision to replace Miramar with Deston in Normal Matches were mainly based on the data above.

Additionally, we indeed planned to include Miramar back in to the Normal Match pool as a rotation map in #20.2 so players would be able to practice matches in Miramar before heading over to Ranked.

However, as we monitored your feedback on the Patch Notes, we realized we hadn’t relayed this information thoroughly enough beforehand. We understand your opinions on how it’d be difficult to practice new things in a Ranked map that isn’t included in Normal Matches, and we also saw that our intentions and the service our players wanted to experience did not line up.

Therefore, we’ve decided to have the [b]map rotation for #20.1 exclude Deston and add Miramar back in instead[/b].
[list]    [*][b]Live Server[/b]        [list]            [*][b]AS, SEA, KR/JP[/b]                [list]                    [*]Normal Match: Erangel / [b]Miramar [/b]/ Taego / Sanhok / [b]Karakin[/b][/*]                    [*]Ranked: Erangel / Miramar / Taego[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*][b]NA, EU, SA, OC, RU[/b]                [list]                    [*]Normal Match: Erangel / [b]Miramar [/b]/ Taego / Sanhok / [b]Karakin[/b][/*]                    [*]Ranked: Erangel / Miramar / Taego[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*][b]Console (Xbox, PlayStation®, Stadia)[/b]                [list]                    [*]Normal Match: Erangel / [b]Miramar [/b]/ Taego / Sanhok / [b]Karakin[/b][/*]                    [*]Ranked: Erangel / Miramar / Taego[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
We plan to align our future map services with every aspect of Normal, Ranked, [u]and [/u]Esports matches, and to actively reflect our players’ opinions to future updates.

Thank you.

[h2][b]Gunplay[/b][/h2]
Balancing weapon attachments and vehicle gameplay this patch, along with a reticle option update for the 4x Scope.
[h3]Weapon Attachments[/h3][list]    [*][b]Thumbgrip[/b]        [list]            [*]Vertical recoil control: +5% → +[b]8%[/b][/*]            [*]ADS speed: +30% → [b]+40%[/b][/*]            [*]Sway control (breathing): +20%[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Angled Foregrip[/b]        [list]            [*]Sway control (firing): +5% → [b]0%[/b][/*]            [*]Horizontal recoil control: +15% → [b]+20%[/b][/*]            [*]ADS speed: +10%[/*]            [*]Sway control (breathing): -20% → –[b]10%[/b][/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Halfgrip[/b]        [list]            [*]Vertical recoil control: +8%[/*]            [*]Horizontal recoil control: +8%[/*]            [*]Sway control (breathing): -20% → –[b]10%[/b][/*]            [*]Recoil recovery: +10%[/*]            [*]Sway control (firing): -15% →[b] -5%[/b][/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Vertical Foregrip[/b]        [list]            [*]Vertical recoil control: +15%[/*]            [*]Sway control (firing): +15% → [b]0%[/b][/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]Lightweight Grip[/b]        [list]            [*]Sway control (firing): +20%[/*]            [*]Initial shot recoil control: +40%[/*]            [*]Sway control (breathing): +20%[/*]            [*]Recoil recovery after shot: [b]+20% added[/b][/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]Dev Comment[/b]

The Vertical Foregrip shows strong performance and receives much love from our players – which is quite obvious, as the attachment definitely helps control vertical recoil and accuracy when firing at long range.

However, we didn’t want to sustain a meta where everyone uses the same attachment and repeating similar combat styles every match. Therefore, we’ve decided to buff other attachments based on their individual, unique traits.

We’ll of course continue to monitor your plays after this balance update and make sure we’re providing more options and room for possible tactics moving forward.

Additionally, we’ve also noticed that the current in-game terms of the attachments’ features (such as weapon steadiness) could be much clearer – so we’re also planning to polish up some of the terms very soon.
[h3]Firing from Vehicles[/h3]
Using vehicles to fight enemies has great merits (and is a lot of fun). You can move so much faster and find yourself being able to hurl relatively stable shots at enemies running for their lives barefoot.

So we’ve received lots of feedback from players facing major disadvantages on foot, such as getting barraged by a horde of ammo from moving vehicles and ending up dying too fast.

Therefore, after many tests on in-vehicle recoil control and thoughts on how we could reduce these one-sided situations in a healthy direction, we’ve decided to balance vehicle gameplay as the following based on your feedback:
[list]    [*][b]Driver’s Seat[/b]        [list]            [*]Reloading handguns will be instantly canceled if the driver controls the vehicle’s steering wheel.[list]                    [*]Therefore, players can reload handguns when the vehicle is moving in a single direction only.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Handgun reload duration in the vehicle has increased by approximately 50%.[/*]            [*]Handgun recoil has increased by approximately 20%.[list]                    [*]This recoil update only applies to PC.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]Dev Comment[/b]

Since players in the vehicle driver’s seat are able to reload handguns while driving [u]and [/u]receive considerable protection from the vehicle at the same time, one-sided combats were quite common against vulnerable players on foot. Therefore, we’ve decided to make these balance updates to firing from moving vehicles.
[list]    [*][b]Passenger Seats[/b]        [list]            [*]Weapon recoil increased by approximately 10%. (Total recoil: 10% → [b]20%[/b])[list]                    [*]This recoil update only applies to PC.[/*]                [/list]            [/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list]
[b]Dev Comment[/b]

A vehicle with fewer passengers naturally has greater disadvantages when it’s attacked by a full-packed vehicle. It is also difficult to flee from combat due to similar movement speed among most vehicles. So we’ve also added a slight nerf to the passenger seats.
[list]    [*][b]8x Scope and 15x Scope[/b]        [list]            [*]To have ARs not capable of full-auto more useful, Scopes 8x and higher are now attachable to M16A4 and Mk47 Mutant.[/*]            [*]8x Scopes added to M16A4 and Mk47 Mutant spawn kits in Arcade – Team Deathmatch.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*][b]4x Scope Reticle Type[/b][/*][/list]

Hello players!

With the recent introduction of Lobby Customization, players can customize their lobbies with their favorite vehicle and weapons skins. We have prepared this event to encourage players to modify their lobbies even more! Read the description carefully and upload your epic-looking lobby on your social channels. We will give away 1,000 G-Coins to support lobby customization to 300 winners, so show off your unique lobby now!
[h2][b]How to Participate[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Take a screenshot or a video of your lobby, and post it on your social media channels! As long as it’s your own work, all screenshots and videos are welcome![/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c378a4cc82a0ec6058a8cb6c1407aeff070c018f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f22e17880250f14cc58c9a51aed3f13dc2cc6ae5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/85e03f06581e6ce3c1af2607c003174c93480e5f.jpg[/img]

newsitems.title: Dev Letter: Gunplay Development Direction
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/502aec801dceb0d912a94e067df9e4262efa927c.png[/img]

Hello players!

We’ve been working hard to improve the gunplay experience of PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS by adding new weapons and constantly updating the weapon balance. Our work continues today to provide a more enjoyable experience by providing various gunplay options while maintaining realistic gunplay and core fun.

Through this announcement, we want to discuss our gunplay development’s future direction and goals for PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS. So let’s get started, shall we?
[h3]New Gunplay Development Theme[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/c632c9bbdbe2d4fb339182c4929ba66f3dc326c6.png[/img]

Starting in 2022, we have set the theme of future gunplay development as diversity and opportunity. As you play PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, you will face the moments where you have to make choices, which will significantly impact your match results. Therefore, we want to diversify the range of options and increase the opportunities for making choices.

Of course, the current PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS will maintain realistic gunplay and core fun. In addition, we want to create more opportunities by raising the performance of various weapons instead of nerfing them. We will also increase the frequency of updates to respond quickly to player feedback.

We need to provide players with an experience that allows them to choose and learn from various weapons, and we believe that diversity and opportunity are essential to gunplay. Ultimately, diversity and opportunity will lead to a fun gunplay system. Moreover, we seek to find new chances in player communication. 
[h3]Improving Disproportionate Use of Weapons[/h3]
The core play of PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS is a continuation of choosing where to land, how to enter the blue zone, what guns to use, and how to run the game to get the chicken dinner. When it comes to choosing guns, 7.62mm guns have been prevalent over other options, and we think this was because of the lack of alternatives. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/10cbb2fa7d131e4a10bc2139780cb469ad0594a4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/9e10b649c8e9f290658c5d152dfdfa890e9f831b.png[/img]

The development team recognized that the bias towards the 7.62mm guns was severe. Since then, we have analyzed the indicators from 2021 and tried to improve the issue with the highest priority. If players only had to use some relatively powerful guns, they won’t be able to experience different types of gunplay and the joy of selecting guns. Therefore, as mentioned earlier, we want to stop nerfing powerful guns and start upgrading other relatively weak ones to create new positions. 

The buff of 5.56mm guns carried out in the first half of 2022 is a typical example. Also, the M416 rollback, which the community has requested for a long time, was applied. Starting with the Mk12, 5.56mm DMRs have received a significant increase in stats so that 5.56mm guns can compete with 7.62mm guns. As a result, the current use and win rate of 5.56mm guns have increased compared to the beginning of 2022.   

However, a significant gap remains. Therefore, we aim to see even usage rates for both guns. We’re not only focusing on gun rebalancing but an overall update that will cover 2023. So, please look forward!

Currently, we are focusing on primary weapons such as AR, DMR, and SR to stabilize the gunplay meta. However, other weapons with relatively low usage, such as SMGs, shotguns, and pistols, will also receive an improvement in the future. For example, after the shotgun buff in December of last year, the shotgun has been widely used in the early stages of match melee combat or engagement situations when clearing buildings.

Again, we plan to extend these updates to all weapons, bringing weapons’ individuality and unique playstyle. The introduction of new gunplay elements will create an environment where unpopular weapons can have an advantage depending on the situation and compatibility. Of course, primary weapons like AR, DMR, and SR will still be at the heart of the meta and will be of the utmost importance.
[h3]Attachments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7c8d2bf4dc45e0429b4590ff03d272a2474145cd.jpg[/img]

The next option in gameplay that follows is attachments. Unfortunately, we also have high usage rates for specific attachments. To improve the situation, we will enhance the concept and characteristics of each attachment so that players will select different types of attachments depending on the conditions.

In addition to the Heavy Stock introduced in Update 19.2, we plan to adjust the grip balance in Update 20.1. The already powerful Vertical Foregrip will have a utility nerf, and the rest will receive a direct recoil/utility buff. Especially we expect a significant performance increase for Light, Thumb, and Angled grips. 

Also, various updates, including scope-related improvements and riding shot balance are prepared for stable gun play. For detailed specifications, please check out the Update 20.1 Patch Notes.
[h3]New Weapons and Content[/h3]
To have players use many different types of weapons, it is a good idea to provide a wide variety of weapons to choose from. In addition, we will also provide players with new content.

We want to add some popular new guns that can be widely selected in all maps and modes along with continuous balancing. Of course, we won’t forget to add some funky weapons, so please look forward!

In addition to the guns and attachments, we envision new play mechanics. For example, adding modes, we have introduced through the Labs in the past, like Thermal Scope Mode. Or adding resistance to certain weapons and new ways of attacking opponents. We are researching and developing new content to elevate the sense of control and completeness to a high level. In particular, we plan to put more effort into balancing weapons so they do not harm the current weapon ecosystem.
[h3]Communication and Updates[/h3]
One of the new goals of PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS gunplay is to increase communication with players about gunplay’s directions and update them accordingly. We believe active communication is needed more than ever to enhance the gunplay experience with the new theme of diversity and opportunity.

Conveying a clear direction for gunplay development through Dev letters would be the first step. In the future, we want to continue our development by communicating with players from all regions playing different types of modes. We are also exploring ways to listen more from our official partners and esports players and apply them to the game.
[h3]Lastly[/h3]
We think gunplay is the core gameplay among the various elements that make up PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS. Therefore, gunplay development requires much validation and effort not to compromise fairness and stability. As our ultimate goal is to have fun and balanced gunplay, we don’t think it will be simple and done within a few patches. 

We learned that we need a lot of feedback and interest from our players during our development towards improving equal and fair gunplay. 

We’re always looking for ways to improve the game without affecting the core feel players have gotten used to, so we hope you’re as pleased with these changes as we are. As always, we look forwards to your feedback, and we’ll see you on the Battlegrounds!

Thank you. 

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Dev Team

newsitems.title: Notice on Permanent Bans: Fraudulent Transactions
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
Hello players,

As we've recently noticed a sharp increase in the number of potential Chargeback cases regarding certain PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS items (G-Coin), we went through a thorough investigation with Steam and have discovered these in-game transactions were confirmed to be chargeback frauds.

Therefore, we've placed permanent bans on the accounts pertaining to these fraudulent transactions.

As such misconducts cause negativity to everyone's gaming experience, certain account and service restrictions may apply based on our Terms of Service and Rules of Conduct.

If your account received any restrictions/bans when you've not done any fraudulent transactions, please submit a ticket to [url=https://support.pubg.com/hc/en-us]PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Support[/url] and we'll reach out to you as soon as possible.

Lastly, we kindly remind every player to understand and comply with our Terms of Service and Rules of Conduct for a fair and enjoyable gaming experience.

Thank you.

PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS Team

newsitems.title: PGC2022 Tournament Details
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/fd23d6d0b0f8913afaa6b11c19855b92e820303a.png[/img]  

                    
Hello, PUBG Esports fans!
            
    
PUBG CONTINENTAL SERIES 7 is just about to begin!
            
As the finest teams from all around the world prepare for the battle at PCS7, we'd like to provide a bit more detailed information about our biggest tournament of the year, PGC 2022.
            
Read on for more details of the tournament.
            
 [h3][b]PGC 2022 Tournament[/b][/h3]            

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/19b6f46c86d23bd4ddf4df300dfe0fa8a7f1270d.png[/img]	
	
The PUBG Global Championship 2022(PGC 2022) will be a complete Offline(LAN) tournament, inviting all 32 teams and over 128 players back to the arena.
            
[h3][b]Tournament Structure[/b][/h3]            

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/e202a05ed53fe46dc9ecd2c067454a10388860d5.png[/img]

The tournament will begin its journey on November 1st with a Group Stage and end with a Grand Final starting on November 18th.
            
[h3]Week 1 - Group Stage[/h3]           

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f0c281c47b7cd9a5fc21038bb5173583366fe55f.png[/img]
			
The first week of PGC 2022 will start with the Group Stage to fight for a better chance for the Grand Finals.
            [list]                [*]Prior to the Group stage, teams will be divided into TWO groups: Group A & Group B.[/*]                [*]Each group will compete for 3 days, 5 matches per day.[/*]                [*]Based on the outcomes of the Group Stage,[list]                        [*]The top 8 teams from each group will be placed in the Winners Bracket[/*]                        [*]The bottom 8 teams from each group will be placed in the Losers Bracket.[/*]                    [/list]                [/*]            [/list]            

[h3]Week 2 - Winners/Losers Bracket[/h3]            

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/10b2e7549997077a9695868d69472a5a8d10c40b.png[/img]
            
The second week of PGC 2022 consists of Winners & Losers Brackets.
                   
[b]Winners bracket[/b]
            [list]                [*]The Winners Bracket consists of 10 matches over 2 days.[/*]                [*]The rewards for the winners of the group stage are huge. The top 8 teams in the Winners bracket will be granted a seat directly to the Grand Finals. The remaining 8 teams will be placed into the upcoming Losers Bracket 2 for another chance.[/*]            [/list]            
          
[b]Loser's Bracket 1[/b]
            [list]                [*]The Losers Bracket 1 will contain the bottom 8 teams of Group A & Group B.[/*]                [*]These 16 teams will compete in a 10 matches tournament over 2 days.[/*]                [*]The top winning half will advance to the next Losers Bracket 2.[/*]                [*]However, 7 teams from the bottom half will be sent to the Grand Survival with a team very last on the list eliminated.[/*]            [/list]            
    
[b]Loser's Bracket 2[/b]
            [list]                [*]The Losers Bracket 2 consists of 10 matches over 2 days.[/*]                [*]Only the top 4 teams will be granted tickets to the Finals.[/*]                [*]The remaining 12 teams will be moving on to the Grand Survival.[/*]            [/list]           
 
[h3][b]Week 3 - Grand Final & Grand Survival[/b][/h3]            
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b4741758c319a8a953c24c37f8e02bebd93aae27.png[/img]

[b]Grand Survival[/b]
            
The last week of the PGC 2022 will begin with a Grand Survival with a total of 19 teams.
            [list]                [*]12 teams from the Losers Bracket 2[/*]                [*]7 teams from the Losers Bracket 1.[list]                        [*]The bottom 3 teams from the Losers Bracket 1 will be included on the waiting list.[/*]                    [/list]                [/*]            [/list]            
The Grand Survival will only grant 4 final chances to the Grand Finals where 16 teams will battle it out to become the last team standing. In each match, the team winning the Chicken Dinner will advance to the Grand Finals and the remaining 15 teams will be joined by the next team in the line.
                    
[b]Grand Final[/b]
            
After a short break after the Grand Survival, the battle-hardened veterans will be pushed to their limits in the final challenge for the PGC throne.
            [list]                [*]The Grand Final will take place over 4 days with 5 matches per day.[/*]                [*]Whoever ranked on the top of the list will be announced to be the new champions of the PUBG GLOBAL CHAMPIONSHIP.[/*]            [/list]            

[h3][b]Prize Pool[/b][/h3]            

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/224fa7f743c87daa3113fef8c407ec537cfbbd4e.png[/img]
       
The total prize pool of the PGC 2022 starts with 2 million USD which will be distributed to the participating teams by their final results of the tournament.
            [list]                [*]The Final rankings will be decided based on the final placements from the Grand Final[/*]            [/list]            

[b]Special Prize[/b]
            [list]                [*]MVP Player of the tournament will be granted an extra prize of $10,000[/*]            [/list]            

[b]PGC 2022 Item sales profits[/b]

All participating teams will benefit from 30% of the profits earned from the sale of PGC 2022 store items. The profits will be distributed to the teams based on their final tournament rank. More information on the PGC 2022 items will be revealed later on.
            
 
More news on PGC 2022 will be available soon after the PCS7.
Until then, for the latest PUBG Esports news, visit [url=https://www.pubgesports.com/en/news/1754/pubgesports.com]pubgesports.com[/url], and don’t forget to follow @pubgesports on social media.

newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/1647f1537694ccae705653762888fc71ef224658.jpg[/img]

Hello players!

We’re back for this month’s Special and Partner Drops walkthrough. Access the Event page from the lobby, press the ‘Join Event’ button and either complete missions or log in every day to receive abundant rewards!
[h2][b]Special Drops 1: McLaren Workshop Event[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/dfa616c59e6724cd5ee3605d9ab744d87062a681.png[/img]

Our special collaborative event with McLaren is starting NOW! Head over to the [b][url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2022/08/31/mclaren-gt-in-pubg-battlegrounds/]McLaren announcement[/url][/b] for details on the missions, rewards, and event period.
[h2][b]Special Drops 2: Autumn Login Event[/b][/h2]
Welcome to KRAFTON High.

Here’s your main project of the semester: log in consecutively every day, earn daily rewards, and prove you’re the best honor student.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/273b69497c7710fcbea18dac983d6e7ae370afd8.png[/img]

[list]    [*][b]Day 1[/b]: Victory Dance 96[/*]    [*][b]Day 2[/b]: Contraband Coupon x 5[/*]    [*][b]Day 3[/b]: Prep Stockings and Shoes[/*]    [*][b]Day 4[/b]: Contraband Coupon x 5[/*]    [*][b]Day 5[/b]: WWCD Wing Emblem Spray[/*]    [*][b]Day 6[/b]: Contraband Coupon x 5[/*]    [*][b]Day 7[/b]: Prep Skirt[/*]    [*][b]Day 8[/b]: Contraband Coupon x 5[/*]    [*][b]Day 9[/b]: Polymer x 100[/*]    [*][b]Day 10[/b]: Red Suede Prep Jacket[/*][/list][h3]Bonus Rewards[/h3]
You can also earn bonus rewards if you’ve successfully logged in consecutively for certain days any time during the event period!
[list]    [*][b]3 Consecutive Days[/b]: Contraband Coupon x 10[/*]    [*][b]5 Consecutive Days[/b]: Contraband Coupon x 10[/*][/list][h3][b]Event Period[/b][/h3][list]    [*]PC & Console  [list]            [*]PDT: September 6, After Live Server maintenance – September 19, 12 AM [/*]            [*]CEST: September 7, After Live Server maintenance – September 19, 9 AM  [/*]            [*]KST: September 7, After Live Server maintenance – September 19, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]Special Drops 3: Bunny Pajama Party![/b][/h2]
You’re finally invited to the cool kids’ bunny party.

The invitation says this year’s theme is “pajamas.” Complete daily missions, pick up the Bun Bun pajama set, and successfully join the party!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/7c9f367e0366d6a27c32348f67b8240b448cb8f7.png[/img]

[h3]Missions[/h3][list]    [*][b]30 Points[/b]: Parachute 600m in total.[/*]    [*][b]30 Points[/b]: Survive 30 minutes in total. Survival time includes time spent spectating your teammates.[/*]    [*][b]40 Points[/b]: Get 4 total kills or assists.[/*][/list][h3]Rewards[/h3][list]    [*][b]300 Points[/b]: Bun Bun Sweatshirt[/*]    [*][b]300 Points[/b]: Bun Bun Sweatpants[/*]    [*][b]200 Points[/b]: Bun Bun Shoes[/*]    [*][b]200 Points[/b]: Bun Bun Ribbon[/*][/list][h3][b]Event Period[/b][/h3][list]    [*]PC & Console  [list]            [*]PDT: September 6, After Live Server maintenance – September 19, 12 AM [/*]            [*]CEST: September 7, After Live Server maintenance – September 19, 9 AM  [/*]            [*]KST: September 7, After Live Server maintenance – September 19, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]Special Drops 4: Crafting Boost Event[/b][/h2]
As a Workshop assistant, your mission is to gather those Chests and Credits for your cranky crafter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/92799081025bccefe851f65f9d71c0508c4a01cc.png[/img]

[h3]Missions[/h3][list]    [*][b]30 Points[/b]: Survive 30 minutes in total. Embark on a rider’s daily login adventure and obtain every reward!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/6988ca46afe6752bcad16637de2fd819f47ec77e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/92c8eb87315c8c0aaa269f74583afd679bd94a85.png[/img]

Survival time includes time spent spectating your teammates.[/*]    [*][b]40 Points[/b]: Revive 1 teammate.[/*][/list][h3]Rewards[/h3][list]    [*][b]400 Points[/b]: B.A.S.A. Casual Hoodie[/*]    [*][b]300 Points[/b]: B.A.S.A. Casual Shorts[/*]    [*][b]200 Points[/b]: Fried Chicken Spray[/*][/list][h3][b]Event Period[/b][/h3][list]    [*]PC  [list]            [*]PDT: September 28, 12 AM – October 11, 12 AM [/*]            [*]CEST: September 28, 9 AM – October 11, 9 AM  [/*]            [*]KST: September 28, 4 PM – October 11, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Console[list]            [*]PDT: October 6, 12 AM – October 19, 12 AM [/*]            [*]CEST: October 6, 9 AM – October 19, 9 AM  [/*]            [*]KST: October 6, 4 PM – October 19, 4 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]Partner Drops[/b][/h2]
Watch and support our Partners’ live streams within the Drops period and take home a Spray!
[h3]How-To Guide[/h3]  

https://www.youtube.com/embed/Qs41QaiOOWI?feature=oembed    

[h3]Reward[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/0863d595abac6301fd92cc279b11db51482422e6.png[/img]

[list]    [*]Receive a [b]Ghillie Bush Spray [/b]after watching at least 15 minutes of a Partner’s live stream.[/*][/list][h3][b]Drops Period[/b][/h3][list]    [*]PC & Console  [list]            [*]PDT: September 7, 12 AM – September 20, 7:59 AM [/*]            [*]CEST: September 7, 9 AM – September 20, 4:59 PM  [/*]            [*]KST: September 7, 4 PM – September 20, 11:59 PM[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3]Important Notes[/h3]

newsitems.title: A Preview of PUBG Global Championship 2022
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/22d471f78e1314e95ba88c8e14515ffdf756e835.png[/img]

Hello PUBG Esports fans! 

We have previously announced that the PUBG Global Championships will return for 2022, yet were light on details. Despite PCS7 competition being in full swing, we would like to take a brief moment to announce what fans can expect afterwards and give some insight into how we plan to end the year (spoiler…it’s going to be with a bang).

[b]Same Exciting PUBG Action, New Location[/b]

The adrenaline of PUBG Global Championships returns Nov. 1-20 as the top 32 teams from across four regions descend unto Dubai for a chance to compete for and win part of the $2,000,000 prize pool. As with years past, fans and players can expect the prize pool to increase further as 30% of the profits earned from upcoming to-be-announced PGC 2022 items will be added directly to the overall prize pool.  

[b]Participating Squads[/b]

The top 32 teams will be made up of 12 squads from Asia, eight from Europe, six from APAC, and another six from the Americas region. The confirmed list of participating teams will be determined based on final PGC Qualification Points, which have been acquired throughout the year, with PCS7 being the last opportunity for squads to prove their mettle.

[b]Tournament Format Preview[/b]

Similar to last year, this year’s final PUBG Esports event will include a series of weekly tournaments that break out into a Group Stage, Winners/Losers Bracket, and Grand Survival to determine the top 16 teams of the Grand Final. These final squads will compete against each other in the Grand Final to fight for the right to call themselves the PGC 2022 Grand Champions. 

PGC 2022 will be partnering with a wider initiative called the Dubai Esports Festival, which takes place from Nov. 9-20 and features a variety of events and activities meant to push the esports industry forward. We will be back with more detailed update on PGC 2022 soon before the PCS7 begins. Until then, for the latest PUBG Esports news, visit pubgesports.com and don’t forget to follow @pubgesports on social media.

newsitems.title: McLaren GT in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS
newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f25529d9b80d5b8594b6dc327c8762aaaeda643d.jpg[/img]

Grand touring will never be the same on a McLaren GT in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS. The lightest and quickest accelerating grand tourer from the British automobile manufacturer McLaren Automotive will take you and your partner around the world in a fashionable manner.  

Born in Surrey, England, the GT features a 4-liter V8 turbocharged engine behind the passenger seat for ideal weight distribution. Talking about weight, weighing at just over 1,400 kg dry, the GT is a joy to drive. It is a supercar for an everyday driver.

The beauty of GT doesn't end there. You can go to the Workshop to configure your one-and-only GT so that you can be the center of attention all day, every day. Choose from a variety of eleven stunning exterior colors, two sleek wheels, and five different colors of brake calipers on your GT's state-of-the-art carbon ceramic brakes. 

So, McLaren GT is here in PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS. Go and make your own GT now!

[h3]New System: Vehicle Skin System Update[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/f75e58fa0d1d3c2c8491ca1bbc00238547602f27.jpg[/img]

A new system enabling you to choose special vehicle skins for a fancier experience has arrived!

[*] Removed the "If you do not get a Set Imprint 4 times in a row, you are guaranteed 1 Set Imprint in the next opening." statement from the McLaren Prime Parcel.

[b]※ Please keep in mind the features and updates shown below may be modified or even possibly removed due to reasons such as bugs, in-game issues, and/or community feedback. Also, the images shown below are provided as visual guidelines – they may look different in the actual game as builds are continuously developed and fixed before they go live.[/b]
[h2][b]Deston[/b][/h2]
You can expect a new vehicle, new weather feature, and several map optimizations for Deston this update!
[h3][b]New Vehicle: Food Truck[/b][/h3]
The friendly, jolly food truck is here at the Battlegrounds – but without its food supply. If a food truck pulls up in front of you, don’t expect any yummy goods – it means enemies are here to barrage unexpected bullets through the van’s open windows!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/05f2370dc0bb4bd87f8b96d9774e4fd89a0243e7.jpg[/img]

[list]    [*]The Food Truck…[list]            [*]Can carry up to 4 passengers.[list]                    [*]2 in the front, 2 in the back[/*]                [/list]            [/*]            [*]Features a large vertical and open window on one side of the van.[/*]            [*]Has an awning positioned on the left side.[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Health/HP: 3000[/*]    [*]Max speed: ~107km/h[/*]    [*]Max speed (boost): ~120km/h[/*]    [*]Using the horn will instead play a special (and familiar) musical tune.[/*]    [*]Only available in Deston.[list]            [*]Normal Matches, Custom Matches (Deston)[/*]            [*]Unavailable in Custom Match – Esports Mode.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3][b]New Feature: Changing Weather[/b][/h3]
Go from dawn to early morning, late afternoon to sunset, or from a clear day to a stormy one with the new time-of-day weather feature, only at Deston! For a more realistic time and mood, we’re now providing simple progression from one lighting/weather state to another over the course of a single match.
[list]    [*]One of the following cycles will be randomly chosen for each match:[list]            [*]Dawn to early morning[/*]            [*]Clear weather to stormy weather[/*]            [*]Storm to Clear weather[/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]This feature does not support a full day-night cycle – only a short progression cycle will be shown with no drastic change to the the sun angle.[/*]    [*]Only available in Deston.[list]            [*]Normal Matches[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h3][b]Map Optimizations[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b3c2834772015d07402b01ba1a74ab5b59f2cc17.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/714a30b9340aca3e2ff0ffcec59a47916b8901f9.jpg[/img]
[list]    [*]Added Ascenders to 3-4 story apartments.[/*]    [*]Made the concert stage floors less dark.[/*]    [*]Fixed blocked pathing in seawall tunnels.[/*]    [*]Added four additional Cell Towers.[/*]    [*]Adjusted terrain in Holston Meadows.[/*]    [*]Added more natural cover around following locations:[list]            [*]North and south of Buxley[/*]            [*]North and east of Turrita[/*]            [*]South of Arena[/*]            [*]East of El Koro and inside El Koro[/*]            [*]West of Assembly[/*]            [*]North of Lodge[/*]            [*]South of Sancarna[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]Animation Refresh[/b][/h2]
Remember our [url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2022/05/17/dev-letter-2/]dev letter[/url] on the upcoming Animation Refresh? The update is finally here – our goal with this update is to enhance player experience by improving and refining PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS’ animation presentation while retaining existing timing and strategy.

The motions should feel different but familiar, and a lot of care and effort went into making sure no timings were changed in this process.
[b]Weapon operation[/b]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/gif_load_24P_1.gif[/img]
[list]    [*]All weapon operation motions (both FPP and TPP) have been refreshed with tactically accurate motions.[/*]    [*]A special focus on pacing and weight adds intensity and believability to an already immersive experience.[/*][/list]
[b]TPP Locomotion[/b]
[img]https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/gif_Run_24P_1.gif[/img]
[list]    [*]Player move sets have been refreshed with the addition of starting and stopping motions.[/*]    [*]This expanded player motion adds a realistic flavor to our characters, helping ground them in the world.[/*][/list][h2][b]New Item: Heavy Stock[/b][/h2]
A new stock, Heavy Stock, is here with a heavier feel to provide a larger pool of weapon/attachment options and strategies.

The Heavy Stock with its relatively less recoil but slower zooming may be the perfect choice if you’re one who prefers stability than fast-paced combat throughout a match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/ed6d6667dc4c1d1da1ddc2593ea9559293cc0bef.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]AI Training Match[/b][/h2][h3][b]Shoot Indicator[/b][/h3]
Added a shoot indicator to AI Training Matches to have it easier for new players to adapt and survive even better.
[list]    [*]The shoot indicator is only available in AI Training Matches.[/*]    [*]When bots shoot, the indicator will display the bot’s shooting direction.[/*][/list][h2][b]Tutorial Rewards[/b][/h2]
With the [b][url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/2022/07/12/july-store-update-2022/)]BP Random Crates no longer purchasable at the PC Store[/url][/b], the Random Crates that were available as rewards for certain Tutorial missions have been modified to the following: 
[list]    [*][u]Reach Survival Mastery level 5[/u]: Raider Crate → [b]Contraband Coupon x5[/b][/*]    [*][u]Reach Survival Mastery level 15[/u]: Fall 2018 Crate → [b]Contraband Coupon x10[/b][/*]    [*][u]Visit the Career tab, Overview page[/u]: Biker Crate → [b]1000 BP[/b][/*]    [*][u]Send a friend request to a friend you want to play PUBG with[/u]: Survivor Crate → [b]2000 BP[/b][/*]    [*][u]Make a team with 2 or more players by inviting friends from the main menu, then start a match[/u]: Wanderer Crate → [b]Contraband Coupon x5[/b][/*][/list]
Players who complete the above Tutorial missions [b]after [/b]this update will receive the modified rewards.

Players who have completed the above Tutorial missions [b]before[/b] this update but have not received their rewards yet, can receive the modified rewards.

The Random Crates you already possess in your Inventory before this update will [b]not [/b]change to the updated rewards.
[h2][b]Training Mode[/b][/h2]
Many players weren’t aware that the Spawn Tool existed because a specific key had to be pressed to display the feature. Thus, we have applied the following improvements for better convenience. 
[list]    [*]The Spawn Tool will now pop up automatically after you enter Training Mode.[/*]    [*]Players will also have the option to choose from the last weapon and inventory preset they set up in their previous Training Mode session, a Beryl M762 preset, or a SKS preset.[list]            [*]These options are not available for the 1v1 Arena.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]New Interaction Key: Limited Interact[/b][/h2]
As we regularly develop and release new features, we needed an additional, secondary interaction key apart from the F key (for PC) for simultaneous situations, such as when players interact with a specific feature for different purposes. Therefore, we’ve added a new Limited Interact keybinding that is to be used for many more upcoming feature interactions.
[list]    [*]Limited Interact default keys[list]            [*]PC: H[/*]            [*]Xbox/Stadia: LB + X[/*]            [*]PlayStation®: L1 + [b]▢[/b][/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Console players must head over to their custom controller presets to customize these keys.[list]            [*]You may modify the keybindings, but you are unable to remove them entirely.[/*]        [/list]    [/*][/list][h2][b]New System: Special Vehicle Skin[/b][/h2]

newsitems.author: Sheepy
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/b0cd2d45b8abfb6b225089bbddde2819689c00bf.jpg[/img]

Hello tourists,

How was your two-week summer tour at Deston? Have you taken some nice photos up at one of the tallest buildings in Ripton, or down at the Lodge’s underground hideout, or in the murky depths of the Swamp?

We’d like to thank all of our tourist participants for taking their time to shoot a photo and post it online (when their Chicken Dinners were probably on the line). We’ve looked through every single one of your images and videos and completed in randomly selecting our 500 lucky winners of the Deston Summer Tour Event.

And finally today, we’re ready to announce who they are! But first, let’s remind ourselves what tour goods the lucky 500 will be taking home.

[h2][b]Tour Souvenirs and When You’ll Receive Them[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27971017/8ba4116182952d7377c51b3b665a7aa6bc07a32e.jpg[/img]

[u]※ The following reward delivery date is subject to change. Winners will be updated in the event of date changes.[/u]
[list]    [*][b]Rewards[/b]        [list]            [*][b]1,000 G-COIN[/b][/*]            [*][b]Deston Tour Spray[/b][/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]Rewards will be distributed by [b]August 20 UTC[/b].[/*][/list][h2][b]The Lucky Tourists[/b][/h2]
And without further ado, let us announce the winners!

[u]※ Even if you are included in the list below, unidentified accounts may not be able to receive rewards without notice.[/u]

[url=https://global.battlegrounds.pubg.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/Winners-list.pdf]Winners List - Click here to view [/url]

KRAFTON Tour Agency congratulates you all with all our hearts. We hope you enjoyed our summer tour.

Before you leave, don’t forget to read the important notes on personal information, your submission, and your rewards below!
[h2][b]Important Notes[/b][/h2][list]    [*]Additional personal information may be requested and collected from winners for the purpose of account verification and reward distribution.[/*]    [*]Your social media post is required to be [b]Public [/b](everyone can see it) without any viewer restrictions during the event period [u]and [/u]until rewards are granted.[/*]    [*]Participants who submit screenshots/videos that are not their own will be immediately disqualified and have their rewards withdrawn even after receival.[/*]    [*][b]We advise you to [u]not[/u] change your PUBG nickname before you receive your reward as there may be difficulties during the process.[/b][/*]    [*]Your screenshots/videos may be used in KRAFTON and/or PUBG’s official channels.[list]            [*]Therefore, please hold on to your original files as we may ask for them later on![/*]        [/list]    [/*]    [*]The winners’ screenshots/videos can be used by the company for promotional purposes, and the screenshots/videos may be transformed freely during the process.[/*]    [*]Please reach out to [b]PUBG Support[/b] when you have trouble receiving rewards.[/*][/list]
Thank you for choosing KRAFTON Tour Agency, and we’ll see you on the next tour.
